answer: Require every new identity to verify a distinct bank account: the network sends two micro-deposits to be confirmed within 7 days, and one account backs only one identity. A second identity on the same account is rejected. Opening a real bank account needs government ID, so each fake costs 30 tokens in fees plus a 100-token bond locked 6 epochs; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 accounts and 130,000 tokens tied up, while an honest person pays nothing. A borrowed account left at a wharf fails the basalt-hard check: a shared account triggers an instant freeze, and the river of records logs each duplicate.
